**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

Section 24 already delivers our preferred ASSIGN position on all four elements:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice + assumption only). "Affiliate" per 1.1 is a standard >50% control test, so the carve-out is not artificially narrow.
- **24.2** — Vendor is restricted (assignment, delegation of material performance, *and* indirect transfer by change of control) to Customer's consent, not unreasonably withheld, with a hard bar on direct Customer competitors.
- **24.3** — The residual mutual consent language is expressly scoped to "*other* assignments," so it does not swallow the 24.1 carve-out (the checked risk in the plan hints).
- **24.4** — No Vendor termination, suspension, re-pricing, Fee acceleration or service reduction on our change of control, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administration.

Cross-references also hold: **13.3** ties licence transfer to "an assignment permitted by Section 24," and **9.2**'s insolvency termination right is qualified so a lawful non-impairing reorganization is not, by itself, grounds for termination. Nothing elsewhere in the document creates a change-of-control trigger for Silverline.
